audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Voice 1 asks a high-arousal question regarding the aging effects of sugar. A gentle, mid-tempo acoustic guitar track plays in the background. (2) Voice 2 begins a professional explanation in a calm, authoritative tone, discussing processed sugar. The BGM remains a steady, supportive bed. (3) A subtle digital 'pop' sound effect occurs as technical terms like 'AGEs' are introduced. Voice 2 maintains clear articulation and moderate speed. (4) Voice 2 describes physiological symptoms such as inflammation and skin issues; his tone remains informative and neutral. (5) Voice 1 provides brief vocal interjections showing surprise. The acoustic guitar track continues without interruption. (6) Final phase: The dialogue concludes as the music slightly swells in volume to signal the end of the information segment and the transition to the product promotion.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Expert Knowledge Sharing -> Problem Identification -> Solution Placement.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience on the biological harms of sugar (glycation and AGEs) on the skin and body, thereby establishing a need for anti-aging solutions, which are then presented as a group-buy promotion for SkinCeuticals products.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: A final screen dedicated to a product layout with group-buy (團購) information and a call to action to check the description link.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively blends educational health content with product marketing. The use of an expert guest adds credibility to the subsequent brand endorsement.
